notes: Swarm Cities source revision targets Sepolia; this assignment performs no on-chain deployment or token replacement. LaunchToken takes no constructor arguments and universally taxes transfer and transferFrom at 400 bps, rounded down, splitting tax 50/30/10/10 between City Rewards, Resource Pot, burn and fixed treasury 0x5b95A971B4583A5f011E9DA082acdD679b870D06; split dust goes to rewards. Deploy GrantExecutor before CityRegistry. Policy must resolve $owner to the same approved operator/treasury address. After both application contracts exist, the token constructor caller (including a factory) must call LaunchToken.setCityRegistry with the reviewed CityRegistry once; the factory/service must support this explicit setup call. Before binding, pool shares are escrowed in the token, while burn and treasury shares settle immediately; no transfer is exempt. This manifest does not execute the binding. Existing immutable deployed contracts cannot be changed by publishing source. The retained hookless native-ETH pool parameters do not establish fee-on-transfer compatibility: services must resolve router/pool support and admission before release. initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96; services derive the effective opening price when pinned policy specifies an opening market capitalization. Independent contributor release review, source publication, artifact linkage, policy admission and deployment remain service responsibilities.
